artifact.summary: Exact Toffoli (CCX) on a 3-qubit linear nearest-neighbor chain 0-1-2. The target position is selectable (default q2) and the other two qubits are controls. It uses the Nielsen-Chuang H/T/Tdg/CX decomposition. The one non-adjacent CX (between q0 and q2) is realized as SWAP(1,q) · CX · SWAP(1,q), so every two-qubit gate acts only on adjacent pairs 0-1 or 1-2. The DE-optimized parameterized ansatz is NOT implemented, because no optimized parameters are available and none are fabricated.
artifact.source_python:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister


def _nn_cx(qc, p, q):
    """CX(p -> q) using only gates on adjacent chain pairs (0,1),(1,2)."""
    if abs(p - q) == 1:
        qc.cx(p, q)
    else:
        # distance-2 pair is (0,2); route through the middle qubit 1
        qc.swap(1, q)
        qc.cx(p, 1)
        qc.swap(1, q)


def build_circuit(instance):
    """Toffoli on a 3-qubit linear chain; two controls, one target (instance['target'], default 2)."""
    if not isinstance(instance, dict):
        raise ValueError('instance must be a dict')
    allowed = {'num_qubits', 'target'}
    for k in instance:
        if k not in allowed:
            raise ValueError('unknown instance key: ' + str(k))
    n = instance.get('num_qubits', 3)
    if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int) or n != 3:
        raise ValueError('num_qubits must be 3')
    t = instance.get('target', 2)
    if isinstance(t, bool) or not isinstance(t, int) or t not in (0, 1, 2):
        raise ValueError('target must be 0, 1 or 2')
    controls = [q for q in range(3) if q != t]
    a = controls[0]
    b = controls[1]
    c = t
    qc = QuantumCircuit(QuantumRegister(3, 'q'))
    # eq_1: |x_a x_b x_c> -> |x_a x_b x_c xor (x_a x_b)>
    qc.h(c)
    _nn_cx(qc, b, c)
    qc.tdg(c)
    _nn_cx(qc, a, c)
    qc.t(c)
    _nn_cx(qc, b, c)
    qc.tdg(c)
    _nn_cx(qc, a, c)
    qc.t(b)
    qc.t(c)
    qc.h(c)
    _nn_cx(qc, a, b)
    qc.t(a)
    qc.tdg(b)
    _nn_cx(qc, a, b)
    return qc
register_layout: qubit 0: control (chain end, little-endian bit 0) when target=2
qubit 1: control (chain middle, bit 1) when target=2
chain adjacency: 0-1 and 1-2 only; for other target values the two non-target qubits are controls

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit (H/T/Tdg/CX sequence on controls a,b and target c)
equation_mapping.explanation: The circuit implements the Toffoli action exactly (up to no global phase) on the chosen target qubit.
The layered u-gate ansatz with DE-found angles is not built. No optimized parameters exist and none are invented. A deterministic nearest-neighbor decomposition replaces it.
Trace fidelity is an evaluation metric for the runner, not part of the circuit.
The DE cost minimization is an offline optimization that is not reproduced.
The DE mutation/crossover update is an optimizer detail, not a circuit operation, and is not implemented.

specification_changes.change: Replaced the DE-optimized parameterized u+entangler ansatz with a fixed analytic Toffoli decomposition restricted to nearest-neighbor interactions (SWAP-routed CX for the 0-2 pair).
specification_changes.reason: Optimized parameters are not supplied and cannot be computed or hardcoded without simulation. An exact known decomposition preserves the target operation (CCX with nearest-neighbor coupling only). This is not the single-shot or pulse-level construction, and it uses more two-qubit gates.

specification_changes.change: Added an optional 'target' instance parameter selecting which chain qubit is the target (default 2).
specification_changes.reason: Allows varying valid instances while keeping the specified default of q0,q1 controls and q2 target.

assumptions: Gate set includes H, T, Tdg, CX and SWAP, with two-qubit gates only on adjacent pairs 0-1 and 1-2
Little-endian Qiskit ordering; default target is qubit 2
Pulse-level transmon physics, leakage and decoherence are ignored
The reported 99.9% fidelity and gate-time claims are not reproduced
